scope: Exact leased public-input adapter around registered CPU proving. One full-strength paired-wrapper proof exercises the durable owner, then independent fresh-process CPU replay. Not an autonomous worker service, full block, throughput comparison or deadline qualification.

implementation.assignment: Only the scheduler constructs Assignment. It captures lease/job identity, ordered dependency Jobs, exact artifact manifest and Arc-backed immutable public bytes. DurableDag exports only after successful journal ownership/health checks.
implementation.input_validation: Checks exact bytes, operation arity, profile/construction, ordered dependencies and derived job semantics. CPU verifies wallets/child nodes before large proving allocations; no wallet witness input API.
implementation.proving: Dispatches Wrap, WrapPair, Empty and Merge through existing ConstructionSession. Only paired-wrapper generation is newly exercised by this checkpoint; the other operation routes still need real adapter-driven proving coverage.
implementation.backend: Rejects GPU-feature builds, active quotient fusion and nonzero/malformed alternate proving switches. No default proof/verifier/ABI changes; approved cubic profile and fresh per-proof CSPRNG retained.
implementation.lifetime: A per-call local preprocessing session is cleared before return and dropped on unwinding. No cache/RNG retained across released job reservations. Warm preprocessing reuse requires a separately accounted persistent-worker lifetime.
implementation.acceptance: Output contains bytes, lease/job IDs and timing/cache statistics, not a VerifiedNode ticket. The owner separately marks work stopped, invokes CPU verification against its leased Job, and durably commits completion.

native_validation.ignored_explanation: Four pinned CPU checks explicitly run in the 3 GiB native service; two crash-test helpers invoked by parent tests. Real worker generation and fresh output replay run separately.

real_proof.source_fixture: Existing independently pinned eight-wallet fixture; only wallets 0 and 1 are wrapped by this new proof. No wallet proof generation or key registration in the measured path.
real_proof.cleanup: All spill mappings gone before acknowledgement, reservation released after owner CPU verification; durable reopen CPU-reverifies the newly accepted pair. Only private temporary store/journal copies are cleaned.
